headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Security Insights
summary: Integrate real-time security insights from Zagitta/gpu-unlock to detect potential vulnerabilities in npm and PyPI packages. Incorporate video analysis tools from aerial-tv for enhanced package review processes. Implement a taxonomy system inspired by cn-math-taxonomy to categorize and manage dependencies more effectively.
